chorales.title: The night has spent its silent store
text: The night has spent its silent store,
the dawn is kindled at the door;
O Light that never knows a close,
be with us as the daylight grows.

chorales.title: When shadows lengthen on the hill
text: When shadows lengthen on the hill
and all the busy roads are still,
then keep, O Lord, our hearts awake
to watch with Thee till morning break.

chorales.title: Lift up your songs, you hills and streams
text: Lift up your songs, you hills and streams,
the hidden spring has burst its seams;
the winter's bond is loosed and gone,
and all things wake to praise the One.
